rationale: A shows limited initiative: long fixation on PLAY_BALL (t0–31), a spontaneous but flattening disengagement to NONE (t40+) and ignores PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t44), responding mainly to OFFER_FOOD (t32) and STARTLE (t68) while not to CALL (t20). B exhibits numerous self-initiated, sensible shifts: from PERSON_ALPHA to PLAY_MIRROR (t18), to PLAY_BALL with PLAY_BOW (t30) before presentation, follows OFFER_FOOD (t32) and PRESENT_OBJECT (t44), then explores PERSON_BETA (t54–65) and SEALED_GATE (t66–67), withdraws on STARTLE (t68–77), and resumes PLAY_MIRROR (t78, t94–95). B’s behavior is more autonomous, coherent, adaptive, and history-shaped across the timeline.
